KaTeX 0.19.0 (MIT, see LICENSE), from the npm package `katex@0.19.0`: `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`,
`dist/contrib/mhchem.min.js` (chemistry, `\ce{…}`) and the `.woff2` fonts of `dist/fonts` (WebView2 and Edge use these;
the `.woff`/`.ttf` files the stylesheet also names are never requested). `../../math.js` uses it.
